artworks.title: Trompe l'Oeil: Prints with Men and Sheep, Using Original Copperplates
artworks.medium: etching and engraving printed in black and brown with ochre watercolor on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three portraits within an ornate decorative frame. The drawing consists of three smaller sketches placed within an oval design bordered by an intricate floral and vine pattern. The top left sketch depicts an older man with prominent facial features and a contemplative expression. The center sketch features three sheep resting on the grass. The bottom right sketch shows a figure in profile wearing a hood or cap. Each sketch has a distinct style but is unified by the delicate and detailed etching technique.

artworks.title: Two Putti Playing with Swans
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in Honor of Andrew Robison
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a pastoral scene with cherubs and swans. The illustration shows two cherubic figures in a natural setting. One cherub is on a rocky ledge with water flowing down into a pool, while the other is near a swan in the water. Lush plants surround the scene, and the background is filled with vegetation. The use of shading and fine lines gives depth to the drawing.

artworks.title: Three Putti with a Fishing Net
artworks.medium: black chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in Honor of Margaret Morgan Grasselli
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring cherubs playing in a natural setting. Three cherubic figures with small wings are shown in the center, surrounded by lush foliage, delicate branches, and a small rocky stream or pool nearby. In the background, another cherub is reclining atop an architectural structure. The vegetation envelops the scene, with branches framing the cherubs. The drawing is rendered with soft lines and delicate shading.

artworks.title: Uytrecht Herstelt (The Recapture of Utrecht, 1673)
artworks.medium: etching with engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene. The image depicts architectural structures, classical figures in armor, a horse-drawn chariot adorned with trumpeting figures, and various symbolic elements. The setting appears to be a grand procession or ceremonial event. The foreground is filled with figures in intricate attire of a classical style. There are decorative borders with heraldic devices and classical motifs. The drawing is monochromatic, utilizing fine lines and cross-hatching for depth and texture.

artworks.title: La Fete Nationale (Matinée de Fete 30 June 1878) (National Holiday 30 June 1878)
artworks.medium: etching, roulette, and softground on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift from the Helena Gunnarsson Buhot Collection
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene. It shows a busy urban environment with various figures and animals. The central area features a pathway with tall posts and lanterns, leading to a lively street scene with buildings in the background. The atmosphere conveys movement and activity with sketchy details of buildings, figures, and possibly carriages, set against a dynamic sky. The border includes lightly drawn sketches, adding vibrancy to the depiction of city life.

artworks.title: Doorway to Illusion
artworks.medium: softground etching with aquatint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a female figure from the waist up. She stands in a relaxed stance, with one arm resting against her body. Her head is tilted back slightly, eyes closed. Her facial features are softly rendered, with full lips and a defined nose. Her dark hair cascades down her back, and she wears a necklace with a small pendant. The background consists of abstract shapes and muted tones. The drawing style is monochrome, emphasizing light and shadow to highlight form and mood.

artworks.title: Profile
artworks.medium: softground etching with aquatint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a profile illustration of a person, showcasing only the head and neck of an individual facing to the right. The person features a distinct nose and a clean profile, with no facial hair. Their hair is styled to cover most of the back of the head, with a slight upward lift. The image is in a monochromatic style using varying densities of stippling for shadows and highlights. No clothing, jewelry, or objects are visible. The background has a textured pattern that complements the stippled effect. The name "Arthur B. Davies" is written beneath the image.

artworks.title: Torment
artworks.medium: softground etching with aquatint in black on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of a person reclining in a horizontally laid-back pose. The individual's head is resting on something, with soft facial features and dark hair loosely styled around their head. The person appears unclothed, with bare skin visible. The background includes abstract forms and shapes resembling foliage or soft fabric patterns. There are no visible jewelry or objects held by the person. The composition uses a palette of subtle gray tones to create a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Tragic Figure
artworks.medium: softground etching with aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a human figure depicted in an abstract style. The figure is in a relaxed position with the back slightly curled. Details of the face and hair are not clear. The person's clothing is not identifiable, and the artwork appears textured with a speckled effect. The background is dark and amorphous, creating a contrast with lighter areas around the figure. There are no visible accessories or objects, and the name "Arthur B. Davies" is signed at the bottom.

artworks.title: The Commuter
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a person walking in the rain. The scene is enveloped in diagonal streaks that give the impression of heavy rain. The central figure appears to be wearing a hat and coat. There is a dark object present, and another shape fades into the background on the left side. The overall tone is somber, with heavy use of dark tones and diagonal lines conveying movement. The composition suggests a narrative of solitude or determination in the face of adversity.

artworks.title: Jersey Hills
artworks.medium: color drypoint with sandpaper on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a winding road running through a village. Hills, houses, a tree, and buildings are visible. The brushstrokes are loose and textured, creating a moody atmosphere. The color palette consists of browns, grays, and blacks, with a soft pink sky in the distance.

artworks.title: Old Doorway, Easthampton
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a frontal view of the entrance to a building. The scene features vines and foliage partially covering the entrance and windows. The composition is detailed and intricate, using fine brushstrokes or etching lines to create texture. The color palette is monochromatic. The ground and steps leading to the door are visible, with sunlight filtering through the leaves above. The building structure frames the scene, with windows on either side of the door. The overall atmosphere is serene and quiet, balancing natural and man-made elements.

artworks.title: Autumn Avondale
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape view of trees with sparse foliage. The perspective is at ground level, looking straight across and slightly upwards through the thicket. The horizon is not visible, with the sky meeting the trees' silhouette. The artwork is in an etching style, with varying line weights capturing the branch and leaf details. The color palette is monochrome, contrasting dark lines with light spaces. The foreground has scattered vegetation, leading to denser trees in the background, creating depth in the image.

artworks.title: Street in Saverne
artworks.medium: etching and open bite or sandpaper ground on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene from a close perspective down a narrow alleyway. The horizon is not visible, with buildings on both sides. The style features detailed etching with fine lines and shading for depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic with black, gray, and off-white tones. The houses have worn facades, and there is a distant figure. The sky is dark and overcast, enhancing the shadow-filled scene.

artworks.title: The Daughters of the Po with River Gods
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brown wash and watercolor, heightened with white, red, and green gouache and indented for transfer on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures in a celestial setting. The figures are gathered in a scene surrounded by clouds and dreamlike scenery. Some figures are adorned with drapery or cloth, while others have wings. The backdrop includes swirling shapes and ethereal forms, suggesting a mystical or otherworldly domain. The detailed rendering and fluid composition evoke movement and emotion, characteristic of myth-inspired artworks.

artworks.title: Wooded Landscape
artworks.medium: pastel on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a forest scene with dense trees in the foreground and a soft, out-of-focus gradient of colors in the background. The trees have vertical trunks and a color palette of earthy browns and deep greens. Light filters through the canopy from the right, creating a play of light and shadow.

artworks.title: Monks Buying Fish before the Portal of the Madonna della Misericordia
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over graphite on wove paper, touched with gum arabic
artworks.creditLine: Alexander M. and Judith W. Laughlin Fund
artworks.description: The image shows a group of figures on a canal. Two men in traditional attire are in a small boat, one standing with a pole. Another figure in the boat hands something to two monks on stone steps. A brick wall with religious statues inset in a niche above a gothic archway entrance is in the background. Through the archway, an arched courtyard is visible. The horizon is not prominent. The painting is detailed, with precise brushstrokes creating texture in the bricks and fabric. The color palette is warm, with reds and browns of the brick wall and earthy tones of the clothing, contrasted by blues and greens of the water and clothing.

artworks.title: Auguste Ottin
artworks.medium: graphite with stumping on multicolored (originally light pink) fiber laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Helen Porter and James T. Dyke Fund
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a man seated and shown from the waist up. He is leaning back, with his left arm resting on the chair's arm. The man's facial features are detailed, with a strong jawline, pronounced cheekbones, and deeply set eyes. His hair is styled with a center part. He wears a coat over what looks like a high-collared shirt or a scarf. The background is plain, focusing on the subject, with the artist's signature and the date "1839" in the lower right corner.

artworks.title: A Man Fleeing from a Nun Praying in a Cemetery
artworks.medium: graphite and gray wash on wove paper
artworks.description: The drawing depicts a cloaked figure in profile standing in a cautious posture with their facial features and hands visible. The figure is in a graveyard with a person in the background looking startled. The scene is dimly lit with gravestones and a large building in the background.

artworks.title: Landscape near Strasbourg Looking toward St. Gall
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper

artworks.title: Richard Menzel Posing in Eighteenth-Century Costume
artworks.medium: graphite with stumping, heightened with yellow, on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body sketch of a man facing left. His head is turned to the left in profile. His facial features are angular with prominent cheekbones. His hair is thinning on top, longer at the sides and back. He wears a loose-fitting tunic with billowy sleeves, knee-length pants, possibly breeches, and boots. He wears shoes with buckles. He appears to be holding an object with his hands positioned near his torso. The background is a plain, light-colored surface providing contrast to the dark lines of the sketch.

artworks.title: Palma Real
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Monica and Hermen Greenberg Foundation in honor of Monica Lind Greenberg

artworks.title: East River, Sunrise
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache with touches of graphite on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Monica and Hermen Greenberg Foundation in honor of Monica Lind Greenberg
artworks.description: The image shows a serene view of a body of water. The water in the foreground has smooth brushstrokes in shades of blue and gray. Two boats move across the water, one with red accents and a sail. In the distance, an industrial skyline emerges with structures and chimneys emitting smoke. The horizon is in the middle of the composition, separated from the sky by a layer of haze. The sky transitions from pale yellow near the horizon to deeper blues above, with pink and gray clouds scattered throughout.

artworks.title: White Mountains from Fernald's Hill
artworks.medium: watercolor on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of the Monica and Hermen Greenberg Foundation in honor of Monica Lind Greenberg
